_about: Autopilot parity (the owner, 26 Oct 2026: "Autopilot functionality needs to be identical across K&M and Gamepad"). The plain start (the autopilot key, the bar button, View held, ASSISTED's A) reads the game's live state first: an objective -> the objective mode, else the waypoint list -> travel along it, else the target (controller\src\impl\autopilot.cpp StartSmart). One row after autopilot_key; the registry row [Autopilot] start_smart 0 / 1.

rows.label: Autopilot start
rows.help: What the autopilot key, the bar button and View held start. Objective first (default): the mission's objective if there is one, else your waypoints (across systems), else the target. The target only: fight, escort, dock or fly to the selected target.
